title: Measuring Normative and Descriptive Biases in Language Models Using Census Data
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. It was designed to measure normative and descriptive biases in language models concerning gender distributions in occupations, using national census data.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on gender and occupational bias.
